name: Morphing Square
css:
.loader { --accent: var(--loader-color); --accent-2: var(--loader-secondary-color); width: var(--loader-size); height: var(--loader-size); background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2)); animation: morph calc(var(--loader-speed) * 2.4) ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes morph { 0%, 100% { border-radius: 10%; transform: rotate(0deg); } 25% { border-radius: 50% 10% 50% 10%; } 50% { border-radius: 50%; transform: rotate(180deg); } 75% { border-radius: 10% 50% 10% 50%; } }
